{{Top}}
A '''comm tower''' was a communications facility that allowed the transmission and receipt of message off-[[Planet/Legends|planet]]. During the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic's]] mission to liberate [[Verkuyl]], part of the plan was to destroy the planet's comm tower to prevent [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] forces calling in reinforcements.<ref name="COI">{{JournalCite|13|Conflict of Interest}}</ref>
